content.title: Paper Collage Explainer Generator
content.summary: Translate an abstract concept into relationships between paper objects and stop-motion assembly. The Seedance companion locks the visual metaphor, color fields, paper materials, depth layers, and tactile sound family.

quick_start.input_format: Abstract concept + paper-object metaphor + stop-motion assembly path + color fields + paper materials and layers + tactile sound family
quick_start.recommended_input: Turn abstract concepts into relationships between paper objects and stop-motion assemblies; the Seedance companion locks the metaphor, color fields, paper materials, depth layers, and tactile sound family.
required_anchors: Use the pinned official MiniMax H3 upstream Skill.
Use the independent Seedance 2.0 companion for Seedance.
Do not copy the upstream Skill body or duplicate it into ComfyUI.
usage_steps: Choose the matching official MiniMax H3 Skill and install it from the pinned upstream link.
Prepare only the assets and facts required by that Skill.
Use the independent Seedance companion when targeting Seedance 2.0.
Validate identity, timing, text and asset responsibilities before generation.
applicable_scope: Turn abstract concepts into relationships between paper objects and stop-motion assemblies; the Seedance companion locks the metaphor, color fields, paper materials, depth layers, and tactile sound family.
Projects that match the upstream Skill's declared purpose and asset contract.
not_suitable_for: Tasks outside the upstream Skill's declared scope.
Cases that require copying the upstream Skill body into this library or importing it into the T8 ComfyUI node.
